inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text:
Well, folks, finally some common sense coming out of Ottawa, though the left-wing panic over it tells you everything you need to know about who these radicals actually care about. Bill C-12, officially known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent on March 26, 2026. And thank goodness for it. 

The left is melting down, screaming about "systemic xenophobia" and demanding the dismantling of our borders. But let’s look at reality: a sovereign nation has an absolute duty to protect its citizens, maintain law and order, and secure its borders. We are talking about tightening rules for Nigerians and other populations trying to bypass our legal systems. Instead of respecting the rule of law and the traditional channels of immigration, the open-borders crowd wants complete lawlessness and the destruction of our national sovereignty to serve their radical globalist agenda. 

This act of border management is about preserving the safety of Canadians and restoring proper authority. If we don’t have enforceable borders and a respect for our laws, we don't have a country. It’s past time we put our own communities and public interest first, instead of bending the knee to agitators who want to throw open the floodgates.
